title: Half-plane convergence
statement:
Let $\square$, $K\in\Dplus(X_{\Et})$ with torsion cohomology, the integer $a$ with $\mathcal H^q(K)=0$ for $q<a$, and the three exact couples (1) $(D,E)$ (truncation couple of $K$ for $f_*$, on $Y$), (2) $(D_A,E_A)$ (the couple of $g^{-1}Rf_*$, on $Y'$) and (3) $(D',E')$ (truncation couple of $g'^{-1}K$ for $f'_*$, on $Y'$) with their spectral sequences $(E_r,d_r)_{r\geq2}$, $E_2=E$, and the filtrations $F^p$ of their abutments $\mathcal H^n(Rf_*K)$, $\mathcal H^n(g^{-1}Rf_*K)$, $\mathcal H^n(Rf'_*g'^{-1}K)$ be as in [def-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-filtrations]. Then for each of the three couples:

1. **(Quadrant.)** $D^{p,q}=0$ for $q<a$, and $E_2^{p,q}=0$ unless $p\geq0$ and $q\geq a$; hence $E_r^{p,q}=0$ for all $r\geq2$ (and for $r=\infty$) outside $p\geq0$, $q\geq a$.
2. **(Finitely many terms.)** In total degree $n$ a nonzero $E_r^{p,q}$, $p+q=n$, has $a\leq q\leq n$ and $0\leq p\leq n-a$; there are at most $n-a+1$ of them, and none if $n<a$.
3. **(Stabilization.)** The differentials $d_r$ [def-sp-exact-couple] into and out of $E_r^{p,q}$ vanish for $r>\max(q-a+1,p)$, so $Z_r^{p,q}$, $B_r^{p,q}$ [def-sp-convergence] are constant from $r_0(p,q)=\max(q-a+2,p+1)$ on, $E_\infty^{p,q}$ exists and equals $E_{r_0}^{p,q}$; on the line $p+q=n$ every page $r\geq n-a+2$ is already $E_\infty$.
4. **(Finite filtration, convergence.)** The filtration $F^p$ of the abutment $H^n$ in degree $n$ [def-sp-filtration] has $F^pH^n=H^n$ for $p\leq0$ and $F^pH^n=0$ for $p\geq n-a+1$; so it is finite, exhaustive and separated, $H^n=\lim_pH^n/F^pH^n$ trivially, the couple is regular and complete, and $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong F^pH^{p+q}/F^{p+1}H^{p+q}$: the spectral sequence converges in the sense of [def-sp-convergence] with no derived inverse-limit condition.

proof.text: **Step 1 (quadrant for the couples (1) and (3)).** Let $(v,L^\bullet)$ be $(f_*,K^\bullet)$ for (1) and $(f'_*,g'^{-1}K^\bullet)$ for (3), where by [def-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-filtrations] $K^\bullet$ represents $K$ with $K^i=0$ for $i<a$ and $g'^{-1}K^\bullet$ (terms $g'^{-1}K^i$, zero for $i<a$) represents $g'^{-1}K$; so $L^i=0$ for $i<a$, hence $\tau_{\leq q}L^\bullet=0$ and $\mathcal H^q(L^\bullet)=0$ for $q<a$. The couple is the truncation couple [def-sp-truncation-couple] $D^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}(Rv\,\tau_{\leq q}L)$, $E^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}(Rv(\mathcal H^q(L)[-q]))$, $v$ left exact additive between the Grothendieck abelian categories of abelian étale sheaves. We use [lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-negative-vanishing] (Stacks 05TC (1)): if $\mathcal H^i(M)=0$ for $i<b$ then $\mathcal H^j(RvM)=0$ for $j<b$. (i) $D^{p,q}=0$ for $q<a$: $\tau_{\leq q}L^\bullet$ is the zero complex, all of whose cohomology vanishes, so the lemma with $b=p+q+1$ gives $\mathcal H^{p+q}(Rv\,0)=0$. (ii) $E^{p,q}=0$ for $q<a$: $\mathcal H^q(L)[-q]=0$, same argument. (iii) $E^{p,q}=0$ for $p<0$: $M=\mathcal H^q(L)[-q]$ is concentrated in degree $q$, so $\mathcal H^i(M)=0$ for $i<q$ and the lemma with $b=q$ gives $\mathcal H^{p+q}(RvM)=0$ for $p+q<q$. (This is the vanishing of $R^pv(\mathcal H^qL)=E^{p,q}$, [lem-sp-shift-identification], in negative degrees: right-derived direct image has no negative degrees.) Since $E_2=E$, the $E_2$-page lies in $p\geq0$, $q\geq a$.

source.place: Lemma 05TC (lemma-negative-vanishing, line 5497), part (1); its use for $R^pF(H^q(K))$ in Lemma 015J (lemma-two-ss-complex-functor, line 7177), which constructs the spectral sequences of Etale Cohomology Lemma 0DDE (etale-cohomology.tex, lemma-proper-base-change, line 18708)

proof.text: **Step 2 (quadrant for the couple (2)).** By [def-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-filtrations] (2), $D_A^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}(g^{-1}Rf_*\tau_{\leq q}K)$ and $E_A^{p,q}=\mathcal H^{p+q}(g^{-1}Rf_*(\mathcal H^q(K)[-q]))$, where $g^{-1}$ is exact [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-exact] and applied termwise. The natural isomorphisms $\mathcal H^m(g^{-1}N)\cong g^{-1}\mathcal H^m(N)$ [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below] give $D_A^{p,q}\cong g^{-1}D^{p,q}$ and $E_A^{p,q}\cong g^{-1}E^{p,q}$ with $(D,E)$ the couple (1); an additive functor sends a zero object to a zero object, so Step 1 for (1) gives $D_A^{p,q}=0$ for $q<a$ and $E_A^{p,q}=0$ unless $p\geq0$, $q\geq a$.

source.place: Lemma 0DDE (lemma-proper-base-change, line 18708), proof: the spectral sequence on $Y'$ obtained from that of $Rf_*$ by the exact functor $g^{-1}$ (the 'details omitted' of the proof)

proof.text: **Step 3 (all pages; finitely many terms in total degree $n$).** For $r\geq2$, $E_r^{p,q}=Z_r^{p,q}/B_r^{p,q}$ is a subquotient of $E_2^{p,q}$ [def-sp-convergence], and so is $E_\infty^{p,q}$ when it exists; so by Steps 1-2 every page vanishes outside $p\geq0$, $q\geq a$. If $p+q=n$ and $E_r^{p,q}\neq0$ then $q\geq a$ and $p=n-q\geq0$, i.e. $a\leq q\leq n$ and $0\leq p\leq n-a$: at most $n-a+1$ bidegrees, none if $n<a$. In the terminology of Stacks 0BDU (3) the spectral sequence is bounded.

source.place: Definition 0BDU (definition-bounded-ss, line 6262), item (3); the hypothesis of Lemma 0132 (lemma-first-quadrant-ss, line 6672): finitely many nonzero terms on each line $p+q=n$

proof.text: **Step 4 (stabilization at a finite page).** The differential $d_r$ of the spectral sequence of an exact couple has bidegree $(r,1-r)$ [def-sp-exact-couple]. The differential out of $(p,q)$ lands in $E_r^{p+r,q-r+1}$, zero by Step 3 when $q-r+1<a$, i.e. $r>q-a+1$; the differential into $(p,q)$ starts at $E_r^{p-r,q+r-1}$, zero when $p-r<0$, i.e. $r>p$. So for $r\geq r_0(p,q)=\max(q-a+2,p+1)$ both vanish, $E_{r+1}^{p,q}=\ker d_r/\operatorname{im}d_r=E_r^{p,q}$, i.e. $Z_{r+1}^{p,q}=Z_r^{p,q}$ and $B_{r+1}^{p,q}=B_r^{p,q}$ inside $E_2^{p,q}$ [def-sp-convergence]. Hence $Z_\infty^{p,q}=\bigcap_rZ_r^{p,q}=Z_{r_0}^{p,q}$ and $B_\infty^{p,q}=\bigcup_rB_r^{p,q}=B_{r_0}^{p,q}$ exist (a decreasing, resp. increasing, chain that is constant from $r_0$ on), and $E_\infty^{p,q}=E_{r_0}^{p,q}$; both the $Z_r$ and the $B_r$ are eventually constant (regular and coregular, Stacks 0BDV). On the line $p+q=n$ the nonzero entries have $q\leq n$ and $p\leq n-a$ (Step 3), so $r_0(p,q)\leq n-a+2$ for all of them. This is the stabilization bound $r>\max(q-a+1,p)$ of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence], whose hypotheses hold by Steps 1-2.

source.place: Lemma 0BDV (lemma-relate-boundedness, line 6292), parts (1)-(5) and the hint of its proof; Lemma 011T (lemma-spectral-sequence-associated-exact-couple, line 5356) for $Z_r$, $B_r$ of an exact couple; Definition 011O (definition-limit-spectral-sequence, line 5219) for $E_\infty=Z_\infty/B_\infty$

proof.text: **Step 5 (the filtration of the canonical abutment is finite; convergence).** By Steps 1-2 each of the three couples is an exact couple (as recorded in [def-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-filtrations]) satisfying the hypotheses of [thm-sp-half-plane-convergence]: $D^{p,q}=0$ for $q<a$ and $E_2^{p,q}=0$ unless $p\geq0$, $q\geq a$. That theorem gives, for $A^n=D^{0,n}$ and $F^pA^n=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^p:D^{p,n-p}\to A^n)$ ($F^pA^n=A^n$ for $p\leq0$) [def-sp-filtration], that $F^p$ is finite, exhaustive and separated, that $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong F^pA^{p+q}/F^{p+1}A^{p+q}$, and that the couple is regular and complete in the sense of [def-sp-convergence]. Concretely: $F^0A^n=\operatorname{im}(\alpha^0)=A^n$, and for $p\geq n-a+1$ the source $D^{p,n-p}$ has second index $n-p<a$, so it is $0$ and $F^pA^n=0$. A filtration with $F^0=A^n$ and $F^{n-a+1}=0$ is finite (Stacks 0121 (7)); its union is $F^0A^n=A^n$ (exhaustive) and its intersection lies in $F^{n-a+1}A^n=0$ (separated); the inverse system $A^n/F^pA^n$ is constant equal to $A^n$ for $p\geq n-a+1$, so $A^n=\lim_pA^n/F^pA^n$ holds with no $\lim^1$ or derived-limit condition (Stacks 012U (3)); and $\operatorname{im}(\alpha^r:D^{p+r,q-r}\to D^{p,q})=0$ as soon as $q-r<a$ (completeness).

source.place: Definition 0121 (definition-filtered, line 4667), items (7), (9); Definition 012U (definition-filtered-complex-ss-converges, line 6317), item (3); Lemma 012W (lemma-biregular-ss-converges, line 6362), parts (2)-(3) and its proof, the filtered-complex form of this argument

proof.text: **Step 6 (the canonical abutment is the abutment of [def-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-filtrations]).** For (1) and (3), with $(v,L^\bullet)$ as in Step 1: the structure map $\alpha$ of the truncation couple is $\mathcal H^{*}(Rv)$ of the inclusion $\tau_{\leq q-1}L\to\tau_{\leq q}L$ [def-sp-truncation-couple], so $\alpha^p:D^{p,n-p}\to D^{0,n}$ is $\mathcal H^n(Rv)$ of the composite inclusion $\tau_{\leq n-p}L\to\tau_{\leq n}L$ ($Rv$ is a functor, [lem-sp-kinjective-computes] (1)). The map $c_n:\mathcal H^n(Rv\,\tau_{\leq n}L)\to\mathcal H^n(RvL)$ induced by $\tau_{\leq n}L\to L$ is an isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-truncation-iso], and $c_n\circ\alpha^p$ is induced by $\tau_{\leq n-p}L\to L$. So $c_n$ carries $F^pA^n$ onto $\operatorname{im}(\mathcal H^n(Rv\,\tau_{\leq n-p}L)\to\mathcal H^n(RvL))$, which is the filtration $F^p$ of $\mathcal H^n(Rf_*K)$, resp. $\mathcal H^n(Rf'_*g'^{-1}K)$ (using $\tau_{\leq q}(g'^{-1}K^\bullet)=g'^{-1}\tau_{\leq q}K^\bullet$), in [def-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-filtrations]. For (2): $\mathcal H^n(g^{-1}Rf_*\tau_{\leq n}K)\to\mathcal H^n(g^{-1}Rf_*K)$ is identified by the natural isomorphism of [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-bounded-below] with $g^{-1}(c_n)$, an isomorphism, and the same image computation (with $\mathcal H^n(g^{-1}Rf_*(-))$ in place of $\mathcal H^n(Rv(-))$) identifies $F^pA^n$ with the image filtration of $\mathcal H^n(g^{-1}Rf_*\tau_{\leq n-p}K)\to\mathcal H^n(g^{-1}Rf_*K)$ of [def-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-filtrations] (2). Transporting Step 5 along these isomorphisms of filtered objects, the filtrations of the three abutments in degree $n$ have $F^p=H^n$ for $p\leq0$ and $F^p=0$ for $p\geq n-a+1$, are finite, exhaustive and separated, and have $E_\infty$ as associated graded, which with Steps 1-4 is the statement.

blueprint_sketch.statement:
The spectral sequences lie in $p\geq0$, $q\geq a$. For fixed total degree
$n$, only $a\leq q\leq n$ and $0\leq p\leq n-a$ occur; hence the induced
filtration is finite, exhaustive, separated, and converges to the displayed
abutment.
blueprint_sketch.proof:
Right-derived direct image has no negative cohomological degree, giving
$p\geq0$. The lower bound gives $q\geq a$. On $p+q=n$ these inequalities
give the finite interval. The truncation triangles show exhaustivity, and
finiteness shows separatedness; no inverse-limit convergence issue occurs.

split_report.summary: Statement made explicit and extended to the three couples (1), (2), (3) now defined in def-weil-pbc-hypercohomology-filtrations (the imported text said 'both'; the target thm-weil-pbc-bounded-below Step 5 uses (2) and (3), (2) being the g^{-1}Rf_* couple): quadrant, the range a<=q<=n, 0<=p<=n-a on the line p+q=n, the explicit stabilization page max(q-a+2,p+1) (uniformly n-a+2 on degree n), and F^0=H^n, F^{n-a+1}=0 for the decreasing filtration F^p = image of H^n of tau_{<=n-p}K, giving finite/exhaustive/separated, trivial lim condition and E_inf = gr. The one-paragraph proof was split into six steps: (1) vanishing of D for q<a and of E for q<a and p<0 for (1),(3) from lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-negative-vanishing (Stacks 05TC); (2) transfer to (2) by the exact g^{-1}; (3) finitely many terms, elementary; (4) stabilization from the bidegree (r,1-r) of d_r (Stacks 0BDV), agreeing with the bound of thm-sp-half-plane-convergence; (5) the finite filtration and convergence from thm-sp-half-plane-convergence, with the explicit bounds (Stacks 0121, 012U, 012W); (6) identification of the canonical abutment D^{0,n} and its filtration with the abutment and image filtration of the definition via lem-weil-pbc-derived-functor-truncation-iso (Stacks 05TC (2)). Source: Stacks 0DDE and its convergence references 015J/0132/012W, adapted to the blueprint's truncation exact couples. No new nodes; Mathlib has spectral objects and first-quadrant spectral sequences but no exact couples or convergence (searches recorded).
